_meta.note: Condition care-pathways (Care pathways & delivery chapter). Source: Abu Dhabi primary-care 'AD Pathway' decks + PURA app workflows (DRAFT 22-12-25). Each pathway carries a persona, IEAT lifecycle (Identify/Engage/Assess/Transform), 3-tier priority stratification → care-team role owner, referral/escalation, monitoring cadence, UAE specifics, and a reconciliation of its thresholds against PureScore's canonical ranges (status: aligned | partial | divergent). Hybrid human-in-the-loop: roles are people the app/agent assists & escalates to. Illustrative — NOT a clinical sign-off.
_meta.canonical_refs: calc-graph.json markers[].th · pillars.json bands · range-variations.json · units.json

hypertension.title: Hypertension

persona.name: Meera
persona.vignette: Perimenopausal, newly-found high BP, low activity; recent benign breast-lump scare.

hypertension.stratifier: BP reading · end-organ damage (renal, LVH) · co-morbidities

identify: Nurse identifies per criteria; prioritise H/M/L
engage: Nurse: care plan, phlebotomy if bloods due, record BP & BMI
assess: GP (P3): review side-effects, contra-indications, CVD risk, lipid + antihypertensive meds
FM (P1/2): specialist review as needed, adjust meds, review CVD risk
transform: Ongoing BP education; adjust care plan; allocate next review by control & risk

referral: BP uncontrolled on 4 antihypertensives with confirmed adherence
monitoring: Renal, lipids, ACR, ECG as needed
QRisk → lipid-lowering if >10% and not on statin

reconcile.note: Matches the corrected BP citation/value (Package C).

t2-diabetes.title: Type 2 Diabetes

persona.name: Hala
persona.vignette: T2DM 5y on metformin, HbA1c 8.2%, BP 138/86, BMI 31; non-adherent (family-first); motivated after father's fatal stroke.

identify: Nurse identifies per criteria; prioritise H/M/L
engage: Nurse: vitals, BMI, waist:hip, foot pulses, monofilament, ACR; adherence & self-monitoring; care plan
Care Coordinator: culturally-appropriate lifestyle, Ramadan medication education, family meal involvement
assess: GP (P3): congratulate stable control, screening + medication review
FM (P1/2): up-titrate, repeat HbA1c 3/12, optimise BP & lipids, specialist referral
transform: Behaviour change; ongoing diabetic education; allocate next review by HbA1c control & risk

monitoring: HbA1c, eGFR, lipids, LFTs (if statin), urinary ACR
SGLT2i safety: DKA / Fournier's / UTI; sick-day rules

reconcile.note: Pathway uses treatment-target bands (control), canonical uses diagnostic cuts — different axis; both correct in their frame. Surface both.
PureScore lacks a frailty gate (deferred flag); pathway provides one — candidate to adopt.

ckd.title: Chronic Kidney Disease

persona.name: Mariam
persona.vignette: Poorly-controlled T2DM (HbA1c 9.7%), long-standing HTN, OA knee pain; eGFR fell 72→59, ACR 3.6; anxious after a friend mentioned dialysis.

identify: Identify CKD 3-5 coded + search uncoded by parameters
Classify by eGFR + CKD risk stratification (H/M/L)
engage: Nurse: BP, weight, BMI, bloods if >12m; teach home BP & sick-day rules; lifestyle for metabolic health
Care Coordinator: schedule follow-up by CKD class
assess: FM (P1/2): optimise meds, review anaemia/bone-mineral, nephrology referral; check nephrotoxics; statin (LFT-safe)
transform: Stable CKD via metabolic optimisation; fewer AKI admissions via sick-day rules

criteria: eGFR <30 or rapid decline ≥25% / ≥15 mL/min in 12m
eGFR 60-89 with ACR ≥3 or other risk factors
Other signs of kidney damage (e.g. polycystic kidneys)

monitoring: FBC, HbA1c, lipids, LFTs, bone profile, urine dip
uae: Sick-day rules to cut AKI admissions

reconcile.note: KDIGO G/A staging consistent with the corrected eGFR ranges (Package C); pathway adds ACR axis.
Pathway uses SI mg/mmol; canonical uacr is mg/g (×~0.113). Reconcile via units.json (uacr SI path).

dyslipidaemia.title: Dyslipidaemia

persona.name: Abdullah
persona.vignette: Strong FHx premature CVD (father MI 60, brother 58), BMI 32, treated HTN, ex-smoker; TC 6.2, LDL 3.8, HDL 1.5, TG 2.0; non-diabetic.

dyslipidaemia.stratifier: 10-year/lifetime CV risk · inherited dyslipidaemia · secondary-prevention eligibility

identify: Search eligible for CV-risk assessment (age/co-morbidities) + severe/inherited dyslipidaemia + secondary-prevention candidates
engage: Care Coordinator: invite for CV-risk assessment; send lipid-lowering info (diet, lifestyle, risks/benefits)
Book high-CV no-comorbidity → GP; secondary-prevention optimisation → FM
assess: GP: 10-yr/lifetime CV risk (UAE-validated), screen inherited dyslipidaemia, confirm secondary-prevention eligibility
FM: optimise treatment plans for co-morbid/secondary-prevention
transform: Offer lipid-lowering for primary & secondary prevention
Genetic testing + cascade screening for inherited dyslipidaemia

referral: Lipid clinic if TC >7.5, LDL >4.9, non-HDL >7.5, TG >10 (mmol/L)
monitoring: Shared decision-making tool with individualised risk illustration
uae: UAE-validated CV risk calculator (not Framingham/QRisk directly)

reconcile.note: Pathway is mmol/L, canonical mg/dL (units.json ×0.02586: 4.9 mmol/L ≈ 190 mg/dL = FH range). Reconcile units; very-high goal already added (Package C).
PureScore scores markers, not a 10-yr ASCVD risk — candidate engine addition; pathway supplies the rule.

obesity.title: Obesity

persona.name: Omar
persona.vignette: Living with obesity; informed of metabolic risk; seeking weight-management support.

identify: Clinical search for weight-reduction-review candidates; prioritise H/M/L
engage: Care Coordinator: assess lifestyle; record weight/height/BMI/waist/BP; bloods (HbA1c, lipids, LFTs, TFTs); 24h dietary recall, activity, smoking, sleep; smoking-cessation & alcohol advice
Nurse: care plan, phlebotomy if due
assess: GP (BMI ≥25, no major comorbidity): CVD risk, lifestyle, consider pharmacotherapy referral
FM (BMI >30+comorbidity or >40): exclude organic (hypothyroid), OSA, obesogenic-drug review, specialist/bariatric referral
transform: MDT plan incl. dietitian; review 4-6 weekly until stable then 3-6 monthly
Track BMI trajectory, waist, metabolic params; relapse-prevention + digital check-ins

criteria: BMI ≥40, or ≥35 with any comorbidity (uncontrolled T2DM, HTN, OSA, NAFLD, mobility limitation)
BMI ≥35 with ≥1 comorbidity, or ≥30 with early metabolic risk (prediabetes, HTN)

monitoring: Weight, BMI, waist circumference, metabolic parameters
Adjust obesogenic & dose-sensitive meds as weight falls (avoid hypotension/hypoglycaemia)
uae: High regional obesity & T2DM prevalence framing

reconcile.canonical: waist th [90,100] (IDF South-Asian) + bodyfat; BMI not scored
reconcile.note: Pathway routes on BMI (WHO); PureScore scores waist (IDF South-Asian/Gulf) + body-fat. For a Gulf cohort BMI under-detects — surface both; consider Asian BMI cut ≥27.5 (flagged in clinical-flags).

mental-health.title: Mental Health (Adult)

persona.name: Fatima
persona.vignette: Months of poor sleep, anhedonia, weight worry; eldest of 4, heavy caregiving load, limited socialising.

mental-health.stratifier: Symptom severity · length of illness · co-morbidity · past MH history

identify: Reception: register + visual triage per clinic protocol
engage: Care Coordinator: lifestyle advice (timing per clinical condition); behaviour-change techniques
assess: FM: clinical assessment, exclude organic (e.g. hypothyroid), PHQ-9 score; assess OCD/psychosis, drug/alcohol
GP: diagnose mild depression for psychological management
FM: refer severe for specialist + talking therapies (CBT)
transform: Treat mild/moderate; repeat meds, monitor compliance & side-effects; complete specialist-review actions

criteria: Mild symptoms, no co-morbidities, short-term illness

monitoring: Visual monitoring — alert FM if distressed/behaviour changes
Biochemical screen / brain scan to exclude organic disorder
uae: Cultural framing of distress & help-seeking; family-context load

reconcile.note: Canonical yellow at 5 (standard PHQ-9 mild ≥5); pathway labels 0-9 'mild'. Align banding to 5/10/15/20 (PHQ-9 Kroenke 2001, now cited).
BOTH lack PHQ-9 item-9 → C-SSRS escalation. Shared SAFETY gap — fix once in the safety layer (Doc 16).

diabetes-journey.title: Diabetes — PURA patient journey

persona.vignette: Any PURA app user or physician referral entering the diabetes screening journey.

diabetes-journey.stratifier: DOH risk assessment (age, gender, risk factors) → IFHAS screening result

identify: Entry via PURA app or physician referral; DOH-standard risk assessment
engage: IFHAS-major: vitals (BMI, BP), labs (HbA1c, random glucose, lipids, CBC, creatinine), PHQ-9, GAD-7, consult + exam
assess: Triage: Normal / Prediabetes / Diabetes; abnormal → follow-up in 7-10 days
Activate pathway: routine follow-up / lifestyle program / physician management
transform: Continuous monitoring + reminders in PURA dashboard
Referral/escalation: GP, FM, internal medicine, endocrinology, cardiology, nephrology, dietitian

criteria: HbA1c ≥6.5% or FPG ≥126 mg/dL → T2 Diabetes pathway

referral: GP, family medicine, internal medicine, endocrinology, cardiology, nephrology, dietitian — condition-based

reconcile.note: Directly matches the corrected HbA1c diagnostic cuts (Package C) incl. IFCC mmol/mol path.
Both PureScore markers; instruments now cited (Kroenke/Spitzer).

prediabetes.title: Prediabetes — PURA prevention pathway

persona.vignette: Auto-enrolled PURA user with HbA1c 5.7-6.4% on prevention track.

prediabetes.stratifier: HbA1c band + BMI + HTN + FHx + GDM/PCOS/MetS

engage: Lifestyle education; digital nudges (weight, activity, nutrition, high-risk coaching)
assess: Monitoring schedule: HbA1c q3m, weight/BMI q2-4wk (self-report), BP q3m, lifestyle adherence monthly
transform: Improved → continue; worsened → intensify coaching + dietitian referral + care-team flag
HbA1c ≥6.5% → CDS-PRE-03 → Diabetes pathway + physician alert + complication screening

referral: Physician alert + T2 Diabetes pathway on progression

reconcile.note: Enrollment band = canonical yellow zone exactly (Package C).
Self-reported cadence → apply q_source PRO confidence weighting.
